detail.longDescription:
I have this simple code which makes image smaller by button press. This works fine, but with one image only - how do I make same button for many images? I have tried to include a list of inside class "image-containter" but it does not helps, only first image in a row being ensmalled. How to make many images smaller with this single button?
/* Base styles for the image */ #my-image { width: 100%; /* Full width of container initially */ max-width: 600px; /* Maximum original size */ height: auto; /* Maintains aspect ratio so it doesn't stretch */ transition: width 0.3s ease; /* Smooth shrinking animation */ } /* The class JavaScript will toggle to make it smaller */ #my-image.small { width: 250px; /* New smaller width */ } // Select the button and the image elements const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('size-toggle'); const image = document.getElementById('my-image'); // Add a click event listener to the button toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { // Toggle the 'small' class on the image image.classList.toggle('small'); // Update the button text based on the current state if (image.classList.contains('small')) { toggleBtn.textContent = "Make Image Larger"; } else { toggleBtn.textContent = "Make Image Smaller"; } });
